message.content:
I'll search for information about wakehealth.edu to help answer your query.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>wakehealth.edu Wake Forest Baptist Health</query>

Based on my search, **wakehealth.edu** is the official website for **Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist**, a leading academic health system based in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. Here are the key details:

## Overview

- **Formerly known as:** Wake Forest Baptist Health
- **Current name:** Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist (after merging with Atrium Health in 2021)
- **Affiliation:** Part of Advocate Health, one of the largest nonprofit health systems in the United States
- **Academic partner:** Wake Forest University School of Medicine

## Key Components

| Feature | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Medical Center** | 885-bed tertiary care hospital in Winston-Salem |
| **Level I Trauma Center** | One of only five in North Carolina |
| **Comprehensive Cancer Center** | NCI-designated (one of 54 in the U.S.) |
| **Children's Hospital** | Brenner Children's Hospital |
| **Research** | Wake Forest Institute for Regenerative Medicine and other major research centers |

## Services & Reputation

- Provides specialized care in cancer, neuroscience, cardiovascular medicine, and transplantation
- Serves as a major referral center for complex cases across North Carolina and surrounding states
- Combines clinical care with medical education and biomedical research

The website serves as the primary portal for patients to find physicians, access medical records, schedule appointments, and learn about medical services and research programs.

---

Sources:
1. https://www.wakehealth.edu/
2. https://www.wakehealth.edu/about-us
3. https://www.wakehealth.edu/locations/wake-forest-baptist-medical-center
